name: canary-db
command: mkdir -p /etc/pgtls && openssl req -new -x509 -days 30 -nodes -subj /CN=state -out /etc/pgtls/server.crt -keyout /etc/pgtls/server.key && chown postgres:postgres /etc/pgtls/server.* && chmod 600 /etc/pgtls/server.key && exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c ssl=on -c ssl_cert_file=/etc/pgtls/server.crt -c ssl_key_file=/etc/pgtls/server.key

name: canary
